title: 第4章 阿克塞尔首屈一指的大海贼
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林北没有任何隐瞒。

他将自己的前世、前前世，以及遇见阿库娅之后发生的一切，都毫无保留地告诉了克里斯。

从一个碌碌无为的普通上班族，穿越到危机四伏的海贼世界挣扎求生，再到被某个不靠谱的女神丢错坐标，最后被变态当成了变态……

克里斯默默地听着，从最初的警惕，到逐渐理解，最后那双清澈的眼眸里居然浮现出一抹不忍。

明明是阿库娅前辈造下的孽，可她总觉得，自己似乎也应该承担一部分责任。

毕竟，替阿库娅前辈收拾烂摊子这种事，早就不是第一次了。

就当是对这个可怜孩子的补偿吧……

听完所有故事后，她抬起眼眸，郑重地直视着林北的双眼。

“……辛苦你了，林北先生。”

“你果然是一位十分坚强的男人呢。”

“那么，请务必拜托你，在这个世界里，也好好努力吧！”

“如果遇到任何麻烦，都可以去厄里斯教的教会寻求祭司的帮助。”

林北感觉鼻子一酸。

这才对嘛！这才对嘛！

这才是穿越者加勇者该有的待遇啊！

他用力揉了揉发红的眼眶。

“克里斯小姐，真的太感谢你了。”

“虽然我现在没有什么能拿来报答你的……但我一定会

“至少，我一定会为了你而想尽一切办法打到魔王，拯救这个世界的！”

克里斯温柔地笑着：“女神会保佑你的。”

话音刚落，林北突然感觉一阵奇异的暖流涌入四肢百骸。

不是错觉……

那是一种从身体深处被涤荡了一遍的轻盈感，像是有什么无形的祝福，悄然落在了他的身上。

这……是来自厄里斯女神的加护吗？

“那么，林北先生。”

克里斯的声音将他唤回现实。

“接下来的事情就交给我来处理吧。”

“太感谢你了，太感谢——”

话说到一半，情绪失控的林北激动地张开双臂，一把将眼前的白发少女抱了个满怀。

“林、林北先生？！请、请不要这样，我喘不过气……”

克里斯的脸瞬间涨得通红，整个人僵在原地，两只手慌慌张张地悬在半空，完全不知道该放哪里。

就在这时，浴室门“吱呀”一声开了。

达克尼斯一脸嫌弃地看着抱在一起的两人。

“……呵，你们两个果然搞在一起了。”

克里斯瞬间崩溃。

Page (1/3)

Lin Bei had nothing to hide.

He told Chris without reservation about his past life, his previous life, and everything that happened after meeting Aqua.

From a mediocre ordinary office worker, he traveled to the crisis-ridden world of pirates and struggled to survive, then he was thrown into the wrong coordinates by an unreliable goddess, and finally he was regarded as a pervert by a pervert...

Chris listened silently, from initial vigilance to gradual understanding, and finally a touch of intolerance appeared in his clear eyes.

It was obviously Aqua-senpai's fault, but she always felt that she should bear part of the responsibility.

After all, this is not the first time that I have to clean up the mess for Aqua-senpai.

Just think of it as compensation for this poor child...

After listening to all the stories, she raised her eyes and looked directly into Lin Bei's eyes solemnly.

"...Thank you for your hard work, Mr. Lin Bei."

"You are indeed a very strong man."

"Then, I beg you, please work hard in this world!"

"If you encounter any trouble, you can go to the Eris church to seek help from the priests."

Lin Bei felt a sore nose.

This is right!This is right!

This is the treatment that a time traveler and a brave person should have!

He rubbed his red eyes vigorously.

"Miss Chris, thank you so much."

"Although I have nothing to repay you with now...but I will definitely

"At least, I will try my best to defeat the devil and save the world for you!"

Chris smiled softly: "The goddess will bless you."

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Bei suddenly felt a strange warm current pouring into his limbs.

It's not an illusion...

It was a lightness that had been washed away from the depths of his body, as if some invisible blessing had quietly fallen on him.

Is this... the blessing from the goddess Eris?

"So, Mr. Lin Bei."

Chris's voice brought him back to reality.

“Leave the rest of the matter to me."

"Thank you so much, thank you so much-"

Halfway through the words, Lin Bei, who was out of control, excitedly opened his arms and hugged the white-haired girl in front of him.

"Lin, Mr. Lin Bei?!Please, please don't do this, I can't breathe..."

Chris's face turned red instantly, and he froze in place, his hands hanging in the air in a panic, not knowing where to put them.

At this moment, the bathroom door creaked open.

Darkness looked at the two people hugging each other with disgust.

"...Ha, you two really got together."

Chris collapsed instantly.
